message:
Capabilities:
[
 {
  "name": "Customer contracts",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Contracts",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Customer (text; required)",
     "Annual value (money; required)",
     "Start (date)",
     "Renews on (date)",
     "Notice (days)",
     "Notice date (computed; worked out: Renews on + 0 days)",
     "Owner (person)",
     "Billing email (email)",
     "Customer contact (text)",
     "Legal review (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Draft (start)",
     "Signed",
     "Active",
     "Renewal due",
     "Renewed (last)",
     "Ended (exit)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Contract managers: every row",
   "Contract owners: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": []
 },
 {
  "name": "Tools and budgets",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Tools",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Vendor (text; required)",
     "Category (text)",
     "Owner (person)",
     "Seats (number)",
     "Annual cost (money)",
     "Renewal date (date)",
     "Seats taken (computed; worked out: the total of Seats in Seat assignments)",
     "Seats free (computed; worked out: Seats − Seats taken)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Active (start)",
     "Renewal due",
     "Renewed (last)",
     "Cancelled (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Seat assignments",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Note (text)",
     "New starter (person; required)",
     "Tool (link; required; links to Tools)",
     "Seats (number; required)",
     "Added on (date)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Team budgets",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Team (text; required)",
     "Quarter (text; required)",
     "Budget (money; required)",
     "Spent (computed; worked out: the total of Amount in Expenses at Approved or Paid + the total of Amount in Purchase requests at Approved or Ordered or Received)",
     "Left (computed; worked out: Budget − Spent)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Managers: every row",
   "Tools keeper: every row",
   "Tool owners: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "30 days before a tool's renewal date, if it is still Active, move it to Renewal due and email its owner a reminder to renew or cancel it."
  ]
 },
 {
  "name": "Spend",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Expenses",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Merchant (text; required)",
     "Expense ID (text)",
     "Date (date)",
     "Submitted by (person; required)",
     "Description (text)",
     "Amount (money; required)",
     "Category (choice; required; choices: Software, Travel, Cloud, Meals, Office, Equipment, Training, Other)",
     "Receipt (file)",
     "Project Code (text)",
     "Team budget (link; links to Tools and budgets › Team budgets)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Submitted (start)",
     "Approved",
     "Paid (last)",
     "Rejected (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Purchase requests",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Item (text; required)",
     "Requested by (person; required)",
     "Amount (money; required)",
     "Category (choice; choices: Software, Travel, Cloud, Meals, Office, Equipment, Training, Other)",
     "Supplier (text)",
     "Reason (long_text)",
     "Needed by (date)",
     "Team budget (link; links to Tools and budgets › Team budgets)",
     "Decision (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Requested (start)",
     "Approved",
     "Ordered",
     "Received (last)",
     "Declined (exit)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Spend admin: every row",
   "Spend approver: every row",
   "Purchase approver: every row",
   "Own spend: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "When an expense is added without a receipt, make it wait on the person who submitted it until the receipt is attached.",
   "When an expense has a receipt, whether added with it or attached later, email Lena that it is ready to approve or reject.",
   "When an expense has a receipt, whether added with it or attached later, email Lena that it is ready to approve or reject.",
   "When an expense is approved, email Lena that it is ready to be paid with the next payroll.",
   "When a purchase request is added for more than $2,000, ask Krishna to approve or decline it into its Decision.",
   "When a purchase request is added for $2,000 or less, ask Lena to approve or decline it into its Decision.",
   "When a purchase request's Decision becomes Approved, move it to Approved.",
   "When a purchase request's Decision becomes Declined, move it to Declined."
  ]
 },
 {
  "name": "Time off",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Leave requests",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Note (text)",
     "Employee (person; required)",
     "Leave type (choice; required; choices: Vacation, Sick, Personal)",
     "From (date; required)",
     "To (date; required)",
     "Days (days)",
     "Decision (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Draft (start)",
     "Requested",
     "Approved",
     "Taken (last)",
     "Declined (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Leave entries",
    "kind": "ledger",
    "columns": [
     "Note (text)",
     "Who (person; required)",
     "Days (days; required)",
     "Date (date)",
     "Balance after (days)",
     "Reverses (link; links to Leave entries)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Balances",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Name (text; required)",
     "Person (person; required)",
     "Allowance (days; required)",
     "Left (computed; worked out: the Person's leave entries added up)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Time off admin: every row",
   "Balance keeper: every row",
   "Managers: their team's rows",
   "Employees: their own rows",
   "Own balance: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "When a request is sent (enters Requested), ask the employee's manager to approve or decline it into its Decision.",
   "When a request's Decision becomes Approved, move it to Approved.",
   "When a request's Decision becomes Declined, move it to Declined.",
   "When a vacation request enters Approved, add an entry in Leave entries for the employee with its Days taken off (a negative number), noted as vacation taken.",
   "The day after a request's last day (To plus 1 day), if it is still Approved, move it to Taken.",
   "When a row is added to Balances, add an entry in Leave entries for that person giving them their Allowance, noted as yearly allowance."
  ]
 },
 {
  "name": "Onboarding",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "First-week plans",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Name (text; required)",
     "New starter (person; required)",
     "Start date (date; required)",
     "Manager (person; required)",
     "Buddy (person)",
     "Team tool (link; links to Tools and budgets › Tools)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Planning (start)",
     "First week",
     "Complete (last)",
     "Cancelled (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Tasks",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Task (text; required)",
     "Plan (link; required; links to First-week plans)",
     "For (choice; choices: IT, Manager, Buddy)",
     "Assigned to (person)",
     "Due (date)",
     "Details (long_text)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "To do (start)",
     "Done (last)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Onboarding admin: every row",
   "Onboarding planner: every row",
   "Task owners: their own rows",
   "Plan managers: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "When a plan is added, ask Aisha to pick a buddy for the new starter, waiting until the Buddy is filled in.",
   "When a plan is added, create an IT task for Jon (laptop, accounts and software seats), due on the plan's start date, and email Jon.",
   "When a plan is added, create a task for the plan's manager, due on the start date, and email the manager.",
   "When a plan's Buddy is filled in, create a buddy task for the buddy, due on the start date, and email them.",
   "On a plan's start date, if it is still in Planning, move it to First week.",
   "When a plan enters First week and has a Team tool, add 1 seat for the new starter on that tool in Seat assignments in Tools and budgets, added today."
  ]
 },
 {
  "name": "Hiring",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Candidates",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Candidate (text; required)",
     "Email (email)",
     "Position (text)",
     "Opening (link; links to Openings)",
     "Applied On (date)",
     "Source (text)",
     "Offer Amount (money)",
     "Start Date (date)",
     "Offer approval (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Added by (person)",
     "Stage (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Applied (start)",
     "Phone screen",
     "Interview",
     "Offer",
     "Hired (last)",
     "Rejected (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Openings",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Role (text; required)",
     "Team (choice; required; choices: Engineering, Design, Sales, Operations, Other)",
     "Hiring manager (person; required)",
     "Salary band (money_range; required)",
     "Opened on (date)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Open (start)",
     "Filled (last)",
     "Closed (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Interviews",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Interview (text; required)",
     "Candidate (link; required; links to Candidates)",
     "Interviewer (person; required)",
     "Interview date (date; required)",
     "Scorecard (choice; choices: 1, 2, 3, 4)",
     "Notes (long_text)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Hiring admin: every row",
   "Hiring managers: their own rows",
   "Interview schedulers: every row",
   "Interviewers: their own rows",
   "Open roles for everyone: every row",
   "Referrers: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "When a candidate enters Offer with an Offer Amount above the top of its opening's salary band, ask Wade to approve or decline it into Offer approval.",
   "On the day of an interview, ask its interviewer to fill in the Scorecard, waiting until it is filled in.",
   "When a candidate is hired, move its opening to Filled.",
   "When a candidate is hired, start a first-week plan in Onboarding with the candidate's name, the candidate's start date, the opening's hiring manager as manager, and the new starter taken from the candidate's email."
  ]
 }
]

Sentences:
1. 60 days before a contract's notice date, if it is still Active, move it to Renewal due and email its owner to ask them to act on the renewal.
2. 30 days before a contract's notice date, if it is still in Renewal due, tell Wade and the owner.
3. When a contract over $50,000 a year is added, tell Wade and Krishna that it needs legal review before it is signed.
4. When a contract enters Renewal due, start a purchase request in Spend in Purchase requests with the item 'Renewal: ' and the customer, requested by the contract's owner, the yearly value as the amount, and needed by the renewal date.
